note: Attic observatory of the third prepositions (cartoon style): starry-blue sloping ceiling, pale blue walls, big brass telescope by the round window (landmark). malgré (girl reading on under a grey rain cloud), durant (boy jogging with his stopwatch), envers (boy reciting a poem in verse with a flower for grandpa), concernant (grandpa frowning at a letter about him), via (toy train over the viaduct), par-delà (telescope sees a parade beyond the wall), moyennant (mowing in return for a biscuit), touchant (girl touching the star chart). Prepositions have no gender. White door back to the pronouns attic (left); little garden gate zoom (back right).
